issue_context.title: KNX light can't update both brightness and color temperature in the same call
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:** 0.103.4

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):** Hass.io

**Integration:** [light.knx](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/light.knx/)

**Description of problem:**

Given a `light` within the `knx` platform, which supports both brightness and color temperature control

```yaml
light:
  - platform: "knx"
    name: "my knx light"
    state_address: "2/0/83"
    address: "2/1/83"
    brightness_state_address: "2/2/83"
    brightness_address: "2/3/83"
    color_temperature_state_address: "2/4/83"
    color_temperature_address: "2/5/83"
    color_temperature_mode: "absolute"
    min_kelvin: 2950
    max_kelvin: 6250
```

a call to the `light.turn_on` service with both brightness and color temperature changes

```yaml
entity_id: light.my_knx_light
color_temp: 200
brightness: 50
```

only leads to KNX telegrams for the brightness adjustment being sent out

```
2019-12-30 17:42:47 DEBUG (MainThread) [xknx.telegram] <Telegram group_address="GroupAddress("2/3/83")", payload="<DPTArray value="[0x32]" />" telegramtype="TelegramType.GROUP_WRITE" direction="TelegramDirection.OUTGOING" />
```

The color temperature change is ignored. This becomes a problem when a KNX light is used in conjunction with the circadian lighting component, which adjusts both brightness and color temperature in the same service call.

**Additional information:**

The cause for this is likely that the update paths for brightness, color and color temperature are mutually exclusive even though a service call can contain a combination of them:

https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/fccb13b76257cc894fcbd219cdba0885f64579d3/homeassistant/components/knx/light.py#L272-L315

review_comments: So now you will go down multiple paths and have conflicting changes?

I think the source of the conflicting changes was sending an ON telegram after eg. brightness so the actuators default turn-on-value overwrote the brightness telegram.

We only send an ON telegram if no other light option is updated. (Line 273). 

Only problem I could imagine is actuator specific. Some don't turn on when receiving a color-temperature telegram only. They expect either ON or brightness. But I think HA ui doesn't allow to set color-temperature on a turned off light.
